title: AccuSure Insurance: A Real Multi-State Agency, Not a Single Carrier
description: AccuSure Insurance is a real independent agency licensed across several states, placing policies with multiple carriers rather than underwriting its own.
author: Insurance Bhaiya Research Desk
keyTakeaways: AccuSure Insurance is a real independent insurance agency and distribution partnership, licensed to operate across multiple states including Florida, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, and South Carolina.
It functions as an agency, not an underwriting carrier — it places various insurance products with partner insurers rather than issuing policies under its own name as the risk-bearing entity.

AccuSure's own materials describe serving businesses, agents, and insurers together, positioning it as a distribution and administration partner across personal and commercial lines rather than a single-product retailer.
As with other agency names covered on this site, evaluating AccuSure means asking which underlying carrier will actually issue and pay a given policy, the same framework used for Amtex and Open Care.

faqs.question: Is AccuSure Insurance the same as Acrisure?
faqs.answer: No — Acrisure is a much larger, separate global insurance brokerage headquartered in Michigan. The similar-sounding name is a common source of confusion, but the two are distinct, unrelated businesses.

faqs.question: Does AccuSure underwrite its own insurance policies?
faqs.answer: Based on its own description as a distribution partnership connecting businesses, agents, and insurers, AccuSure functions as an agency rather than an underwriting carrier — always confirm which specific insurer is issuing any policy quoted through it.

content.text: [AccuSure](/qa/accusure-insurance/) Insurance is a genuine, licensed independent insurance agency operating as a partnership that offers various insurance products and services across several states, rather than a single [insurance carrier](/learn/what-is-an-insurer/) issuing policies under its own underwriting authority.
Where AccuSure Operates and What It Does

According to AccuSure's own published materials, it is licensed in Florida, Georgia, Michigan, North Carolina, and South Carolina, offering products spanning personal insurance lines, employee benefits, cybersecurity coverage, payroll-adjacent services, and mortgage-related products. It describes itself as sitting at the intersection of businesses, agents, and insurers — language consistent with a distribution and administration partnership rather than a single retail insurance shop.
Agency, Not Carrier: Why the Distinction Matters Here Too

As with [Amtex Auto Insurance](/qa/is-amtex-auto-insurance-legit/) and [Open Care](/learn/open-care-life-insurance/), AccuSure's role is to place your policy with an underlying carrier rather than to underwrite it directly. Evaluating a quote that comes through AccuSure means asking which specific insurance company will actually issue and pay the policy, then checking that carrier's licensing and financial-strength rating separately — the same framework covered in our [insurance company legitimacy guide](/learn/insurance-company-reviews-is-brand-insurance-legit/).

content.title: A Recurring Pattern Worth Recognizing
content.text: Several agency and company names on this site — Amtex, Open Care, and now AccuSure — share a similar structure: a real, licensed distribution business whose own name appears far more prominently in search results and marketing than the underlying carrier that actually bears the insurance risk. Asking who underwrites the policy is the single most useful question across all of them.
